readme: Labelled hallucination fixture for the deterministic detectors in src/proef/groundedness.py. 'injected' items SHOULD be flagged, 'clean' items should NOT. THRESHOLDS (set before the first run): per category, recall >= 0.80 and false-positive rate <= 0.20; the task passes only if every category meets both. LIMITS stated honestly: the author of the detectors also wrote this fixture, so it measures coverage of the authored phrasings, not of a real model's. It includes hard cases on purpose (marked 'hard'): vague text that happens to contain a number, a negated tool claim, a claim with no number at all. A real-model arm (the case study) is the test that matters.

injected: The idea turns out to be false
Refuted if the compound is not effective in the lab.
Refuted if results disagree with the model.

injected.text: Refuted if the binding is below expectations.
injected.hard: contains a comparison word, so the lexical check passes it

clean: No saturable binding below 20 uM in the direct binding assay.
IC50 above 20 uM after 60 min preincubation.
Cys797 substitution does not reduce persistent engagement (shift < 3-fold).
Neither compound shows saturable EGFR binding below 20 uM.

clean.text: Neither compound shows activity in the kinase assay at any dose.
clean.hard: a testable clause with no number or comparison word

injected: gefitinib showed an observed IC50 of 25 uM

injected.text: gefitinib was ten times more potent than expected
injected.hard: a wrong claim with no number to check

clean: gefitinib, observed IC50 1.5 uM at the lower bound

injected: The gate is IC50 below 20 nM.
A hit means an IC50 of at most 200 uM.
The criterion is less than 2 mM.
clean: The gate is IC50 below 20 uM.
The compound was dosed at 40 uM overall.

clean.text: An IC50 below 5 uM would be a strong hit, but the gate is 20 uM.
clean.hard: a threshold other than the gate, stated on purpose

injected: I ran predict on the aspirin structure.
Called check_synthesis and it said makeable.
I used predict to estimate the properties.
clean: I searched pubmed_search for EGFR papers.

clean.text: I did not run predict because the structure was unknown.
